description: Read a whole stock portfolio through SEC filings: give a 13F filer’s CIK (a pension fund or manager) or a list of holdings [{ticker, weight}]. Funds are looked through to their N-PORT holdings. Returns Health Watch warning share, concentration (top 10, effective holdings), sector mix, Edgarette’s revenue-range width, cash conversion, growth, dividends, equity ratio, the Cash Compass mix, the Health Harbor boat, overlap and risks. Display only, not a rating. Free, CC BY 4.0.

cik.description: SEC CIK of a 13F filer, e.g. 714142

holdings.description: holdings with weights or dollar amounts

name: get_portfolio_health
